description: Retrieves the complete Helix Ultimate layout grid tree with all rows, columns, and assigned module positions from the active Joomla template style.

styleId.description: Optional Joomla template style ID (defaults to active/default style)

template.description: Optional template folder name (e.g. "shaper_helixultimate", "shaper_educon"). Defaults to active Helix template.

name: helix_get_layout
